items.title: Instron Cycle for Survival
items.summary: Riding Together for a Greater Purpose From the moment the music started to the final pedal, Instron’s 2026 Cycle for Survival event was a powerful mix of energy, emotion and purpose. Stories from patients and survivors filled the room, inspiring participants to push themselves—not for bragging rights, but to raise as many dollars as possible for rare cancer research.

items.title: ITW Board of Directors Declares Quarterly Dividend
items.summary: GLENVIEW, Ill., Feb. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of Illinois Tool Works Inc. (NYSE: ITW) declared a dividend on the company's common stock of $1.61 per share for the first quarter of 2026. The dividend equates to $6.44 per share on a full-year basis. The dividend will be paid on April 9, 2026 to shareholders of record as of March 31, 2026. items.summary: GLENVIEW, Ill., Oct. 29, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of Illinois Tool Works Inc.
